Frequently asked questions

1. How do I pay for my order?

Pay by card online or in cash on delivery.

Businesses can pay by invoice.

2. How long does delivery take?

Within Boston — one or two days.
Nationwide — up to a week.

3. Can I return an item?

Yes, within 14 days.
